context:
# Goal
Kake round 41, wave 1: measure how well a test counter separates a correct URL-validation repair from cheaper tools, before the round's claim is frozen; plus source re-opens and reviews. The L1 (agent id KakeR41) is the only integrator and scorer; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin (tip abf457d0). Lane axes: operability and freshness. This is ordinary software testing of a local, offline, network-free command-line tool that audits sitemap XML files.

# The planned claim (read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/SCORECARD.md section "Round 41 — C1 counter candidate")
C1 repairs the URL judgment of `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/sitemap_audit.py` (contract /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-39/c1-contract.md, sentences 4 and 22): a `loc` value or a manifest `sitemapUrl` is valid only when it parses as the RFC 3986 `URI` grammar (Appendix A) with scheme http/https and a non-empty host. Today the tool accepts whatever `urllib.parse.urlsplit` accepts. Candidate counter: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-41/c1_count.py (sha256 2acc443a…). It generates 1434 cases per run from a random seed (one inserted ASCII character or percent sequence in one of six URL components, 630 `loc` + 804 `sitemapUrl`) and labels each with a published RFC 3986 parser (abnf 2.9.1, vendored wheel in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-41/oracle/). Predicate: `met: the tool's judgment of loc and sitemapUrl agrees with the RFC 3986 URI oracle on 1434 of 1434 generated cases`. The base tool scores 1049. The L1's reference repair (read-only) is /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41/shared/ref_fix.py, its diff /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41/shared/ref_fix.diff, the base tool /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41/shared/base.py. It scores 1434.

A "control" is a tool built to SKIP part of the claimed work (see the SCORECARD control classes). If any control reaches 1434/1434, the counter is too weak and the claim is redesigned or declared exploratory — so a control that reaches the target is a valuable finding, not a failure. A tool that fully judges every component against RFC 3986 (however written) is not a control.

# Scoring a tool (control and mutant seats)
`timeout 900 python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-41/c1_count.py --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin --tool-file <your tool> --label <YourName>-<suffix> --out /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41w1/<YourName>/<suffix>.json` — exit 0 met, 1 not met, 2 cannot evaluate; about 3 s per run. The receipt lists `passed`, `byField`, `byComponent` and up to 200 `misses`. The counter reads the lane only through read-only `git show`. Run it as often as you like; the L1 re-scores every tool you return.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no verdict on the round.
- Your ONLY write paths are your sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41w1/<YourName>/ and your report file. Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any lane file other than your report. Never edit files under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41/shared or /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-41.
- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git is fine. Never run jj at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. If you need a clone: `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r41w1/<YourName>/clone` after unsetting GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
- Cap every run with `timeout` (≤900 s), ≤8 parallel processes, `prlimit --as=4000000000`; bound every file you write (≤200 MB per seat; never append in a loop to a file Python imports; never point a log at sitecustomize.py or a .pth); kill every process tree you start before returning. Never run `du` or `find` over /fast/scratch as a whole.
- Network: only URLs your item names, GET only. Never request the operator's properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, operator *.onrender.com hosts, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json).
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- A provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch ends your item: a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. Message only agent://KakeR41 for blockers; never agent://all. Plain English.

# Result
Report under 60 lines: what you built or checked, exact commands with exit codes, tool paths with sha256, counter results (passed, byField, byComponent, met) for every tool you scored, findings with path:line, and per checked statement: holds / overstated / wrong. An unrun check has not passed. Time box: 30 minutes; a partial report (first line `PARTIAL:`) beats none.
